tldr: Uranus through the 11th house disrupts friends, groups, community, networks, and future plans.
body:
When Uranus moves through your 11th house, it interrupts the usual pattern around friends, groups, audience, networks, community, hopes, and where you belong. You may notice who you are connected to, which groups still feel alive, and what kind of future you want to be part of.

You may need more space, honesty, freedom, experimentation, or a break from the old setup. It can help you see where the current pattern has become too small or too false.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for seeing where belonging supports you and where it has become performative.

The caution: Watch for changing everything just to get relief from one pressure point. The risk is staying attached to a group, plan, or audience that no longer fits.

Uranus moves through this house for a long chapter. Give change room without throwing away the parts of life that still matter.
